api_offline.client_message: Local API is offline. The app will continue using local JSON snapshots.
api_offline.recommended_action: Start the local API from Settings or continue in snapshot mode.
api_offline.technical_message: Local API status file is missing, stale, or reports a failed state.

diagnostics_warning.client_message: Diagnostics found an item that needs attention.
diagnostics_warning.recommended_action: Open Diagnostics and review the latest report.

export_incomplete.recommended_action: Rebuild social export packs after reviewing approved clips.
export_incomplete.technical_message: Social export manifest or history indicates missing assets.

ffmpeg_unavailable.client_message: FFmpeg is unavailable, so media processing cannot run.
ffmpeg_unavailable.technical_message: ffmpeg executable was not found on PATH.

ffprobe_unavailable.client_message: FFprobe is unavailable, so media analysis cannot run.
ffprobe_unavailable.technical_message: ffprobe executable was not found on PATH.

media_invalid.client_message: One or more media files could not be analyzed.
media_invalid.recommended_action: Repair project media or replace invalid source files.
media_invalid.technical_message: ffprobe/ffmpeg failed on a media asset.

media_missing.client_message: Older missing media references were skipped.
media_missing.recommended_action: Run Repair Project Media, then rerun Full Media Prep.
media_missing.technical_message: A source or clip path referenced by JSON/runtime state does not exist.

path_mismatch.client_message: The active project path may not match the project containing your media.
path_mismatch.recommended_action: Select the project folder that contains content_inbox.
path_mismatch.technical_message: Runtime project root, manifest root, or activeProjectRoot are inconsistent.

project_invalid.recommended_action: Run project validation and repair missing folders/files.
project_invalid.technical_message: Required project folders or runtime files are missing/corrupt.

school_warning.client_message: Color or Audio School found clips that need review.
school_warning.technical_message: Color School or Audio School report status is warn.

task_failed.recommended_action: Open Diagnostics and retry the task if it is safe.

unknown.client_message: An unknown local runtime issue was detected.

worker_stale.recommended_action: Run worker cleanup or restart the worker.
worker_stale.technical_message: Worker heartbeat is stale or worker status is stale.
